notes: Runtime captures (xcrun simctl io screenshot) of a Debug build on the persistent iPhone Duo (closed), on the Sample board's built-in sample data. The Sample board screens open through its saved mode, as on a relaunch, via the launch argument -sampleBoard.v1 YES (and -ScreenshotTab for the tab); Connect used -sampleBoard.v1 NO. connect-over-sample-board.png used the Debug launch argument -ScreenshotConnect (starts Connect GitHub as a tap would); its code is a real, unapproved GitHub device code that expired unused. board.png, people.png and people-initials.png were recaptured at the later sourceCommit after the sample people became made-up GitHub handles (people.png and people-initials.png are the same capture); the Sample board doesn't read the App Group avatar cache, so its people show initials, and nothing is fetched over the network.
